description: This file defines several classes related to CRM case management in an OpenERP module, including case categories, stages, and configuration wizards, with methods for workflow operations and module interactions.

classes.name: crm_case_category2
classes.description: Defines a category (category2) for CRM cases, with name and section association.

classes.name: crm_case_stage
classes.description: Represents stages of CRM cases, with ordering and section linkage.

classes.name: crm_cases
classes.description: Extends CRM case functionality, including workflow methods like stage_next and onchange_case_id.

classes.name: crm_menu_config_wizard
classes.description: Wizard for configuring CRM menu options and importing related XML data, with methods for creation and cancellation actions.

methods.name: stage_next
methods.description: Advances the case to the next stage within its section.

methods.name: onchange_case_id
methods.description: Updates case details based on selected case ID, including partner info.

methods.name: action_create
methods.description: Creates configuration based on wizard selections, importing XML files and updating modules.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels the wizard operation, closing the form.
